answer: Sybil resistance via commit-reveal on a shared oasis ledger: each agent commits a hash of its private work, then reveals after a tide window. A glacier of frozen stakes locks capital until reveal; mismatched or delayed reveals slash the stake. An attacker forging N identities must lock N glacier stakes through the tide, with oasis consensus only accepting unique reveals, so cost grows with N while honest agents pay only one stake refundable on success.
